title: Benchmark scenarios live in bench_* modules
goal: benchmarks.py keeps its list, run and report commands, the SCENARIOS registry and the benchmarks.csv schema, while the harness and report tables live in bench_core.py and bench_report.py and the scenarios in bench_lookup.py, bench_retrieval.py, bench_querylog.py and bench_install.py; report --check and the suite pass

gates.question: Which benchmarks.py parts move out, given the co-change report?
options: harness, report and the four scenario families
gates.recommendation: harness, report and the four scenario families
gates.answer: harness, report and the four scenario families

notes: Families by the registry: lookup (headless, subagents, models, router, howto, partial, files-*, host-lookups, always-on, kb-lookup-agent, navigation), retrieval (retrieval, verdict, doc2query, tool-speed), querylog (querylog-hooks, querylog-pipeline, redaction, research), install (ingest, host-roots, kbpy, new-model). No paid run is needed to prove the move: report --check and the unit tests cover it.
